text:
cara: Quick coordination note: PR #4410 updates /embed batch request schema. The example shows embeddings: [ [0.1, 0.2] ] but the schema now requires an object with \"inputs\" array. Need to fix examples across docs and SDK snippets.

lee: Thanks for the flag. Which SDK snippets are affected? I remember Python and JS have inline examples.

toni: Also check the API ref sample response: it currently shows a top-level \"embeddings\" field with single vector; new response nests items under \"data\" like other endpoints. Might confuse users.

cara: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4410 -- top of file changed, plus examples in sdk_snippets/embed_examples.md.

docs-bot: Checklist added to PR: update request examples (curl/python/js), update response example and OpenAPI example object, bump examples version.

lee: I'll update the Python snippet to use {"inputs": ["text1", "text2"]}. Also change the sample response to show {"data": [{"embedding": [0.01, 0.02], "index":0}, ...]}.

toni: For the JS snippet, prefer the new client shape: client.embeddings.create({model, inputs}). Also add a note about older clients that accepted a bare array but this behavior is deprecated.

cara: Can we add a small migration note in the API reference: "Previously accepted bare array format; please migrate to {inputs: [...]}. We will remove array-coercion on 2026-05-01."

docs-bot: Reminder set: update OpenAPI examples (request/response) and run docs build.

lee: I'll open a follow-up PR to adjust examples and add a one-line migration guide and a sed one-liner for bulk updates.

toni: I'll review and add the JS snippet patch. Also update the examples index so the sidebar examples link to the new shapes.

cara: Great. Ping me when both PRs are ready. Thanks! :thumbsup:
